summary: Tech/Board View – header avatars solid blue instead of the design's grey initials
description:
h3. Preconditions

* Role: Admin.
* A technician with no profile photo.

h3. Environment

* Staging — app.staging.shopview.com, Chrome 154 / Windows 10.

h3. Steps to reproduce

# Select Tech View and find the group of a technician with no photo.
# Inspect the avatar in the group header and the header name.
# Select Board View and inspect the same technician's column header avatar.
# In the design file (Work Orders → Tech View and Board View), compare a header avatar for a technician without a photo.

h3. Expected result

Per the design (Tech View and Board View headers, e.g. "BM" Brenda Martinez) and S2-R12 / S3-R12:

* The avatar is a light-grey circle with dark initials.
* The header name is ≈16px, weight 600 (estimated from the design file).

h3. Actual result

In both views:

* The avatar is a 28px circle with a solid blue background (class {{bg-primary}}, rgb 56, 116, 255) and white initials.
* The header name is 14px, weight 600.



*Evidence:* 

!header_avatar_staging_vs_design.png|width=780,alt="header_avatar_staging_vs_design.png"!

----

*Test cases for this design issue:*

* [C590117|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/590117] Tech View group header shows grip, arrow, grey initials avatar, name and count
* [C590119|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/590119] Board View column header shows grip, avatar, name, pin and count as designed
